Bihar to dismiss over 3,000 teachers for alleged fake degrees

Bihar's government plans to dismiss more than 3,000 teachers accused of holding fake educational degrees. The state's Education Minister stated this action is the start of a broader campaign against irregularities in the education sector. The government also intends to recover approximately Rs 1,400 crore in salaries paid to these teachers, with interest.
